title: Session 11 follow-up — 16 sources not already on main

entries.quote: Fetched directly 2026-09-21. The requested montgomerycountymd.gov/elections/ path resolved to this Board page. Observed links: "Official 2026 Gubernatorial Primary Election Results
entries.observation: Fetched directly 2026-09-21. The requested montgomerycountymd.gov/elections/ path resolved to this Board page. Observed links: "Official 2026 Gubernatorial Primary Election Results", "Official 2026 Gubernatorial Primary Election Results for Montgomery County", and "Data Files (including precinct-level) for the 2026 Gubernatorial Election Results". "Next Board Meeting: September 28, at 2:00 p.m." Media advisories on the page: "MONTGOMERY COUNTY BOARD OF ELECTIONS DROP BOXES FOR THE 2026 GUBERNATORIAL GENERAL ELECTION ARE AVAILABLE" and "MONTGOMERY COUNTY BOARD OF ELECTIONS CELEBRATES NATIONAL VOTER REGISTRATION DAY ON TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 15, 2026". Also a "2026 Gubernatorial General Ballots" link. A petition-determination notice says the Committee to Control MoCo Spending has not submitted a sufficient number of legally valid petition signatures to have the question appear on the 2026 General Election ballot.

entries.quote: Fetched directly 2026-09-21. shelbyvote.com resolved to electionsshelbytn.gov. Heading: "SHELBY COUNTY IS OUR HOME" / "VOTE FOR OUR FUTURE". Observed: "To vote in an election, your
entries.observation: Fetched directly 2026-09-21. shelbyvote.com resolved to electionsshelbytn.gov. Heading: "SHELBY COUNTY IS OUR HOME" / "VOTE FOR OUR FUTURE". Observed: "To vote in an election, your Voter Registration Application must be received in our office, or postmarked, 30 days before the election." Requirements listed: US citizen, at least 18 years old on or before the next election, resident of Shelby County, and felony voting rights restored. Absentee section: "Tennessee law requires that you list a reason to vote absentee." FAQ: "We begin accepting Absentee Ballot Applications 90 days before an election. The deadline to request an application is 10 days before Election Day." Mail address 980 Nixon Dr. Memphis, TN 38134. A banner links the Tennessee Secretary of State "2026 Congressional Redistricting" announcement. A November 3, 2026 absentee application PDF is linked.

Mission: "promote voter education, administer an efficient voting process, maintain an accurate voter registration database". 2026 Gubernatorial Election links: Filed Candidates, 2026 Gubernatorial General Ballot, 2026 Ballot Questions. Primary dates on the page: "Early Voting - June 11, 2026 through June 18, 2026 (7am - 8pm)"; "Election Day - June 23, 2026 - 7am - 8pm". General dates: "Early Voting - October 22, 2026 through October 29, 2026 (7am - 8pm)"; "Election Day - November 3, 2026 - 7am - 8pm". Election Administrator Wendy Honesty-Bey; 1100 Mercantile Lane, Suite 115A, Largo, MD 20774; 301-341-7300. Board president Beatrice P. Tignor (D).

entries.observation: Fetched directly 2026-09-21. The /web/gwinnett/departments/elections path resolved here. Heading: "Elections". Observed: "The Voter Registrations and Elections Office is a division of the County Administrator's office and is overseen by the Gwinnett County Board of Voter Registrations and Elections." Duties listed include registering voters, administering federal, state, county and special elections, assisting military and overseas voters, testing voting equipment, and acting as filing officer for campaign disclosure reports. Links: Check/Update Registration, Find Polling Location, Absentee Voting, View Sample Ballot, Schedule, Results. Page note: "Any interaction with the Department of Drivers Services (DDS) may have affected your voter registration information."

entries.quote: Fetched directly 2026-09-21. Heading: "Elections/ Voter Registration". Observed notice: "The Fort Bend County Election Administration Office will be closed on Friday, September 25,
entries.observation: Fetched directly 2026-09-21. Heading: "Elections/ Voter Registration". Observed notice: "The Fort Bend County Election Administration Office will be closed on Friday, September 25, 2026, in observance of County Fair Day. Normal office operations will resume on Monday, September 28, 2026." Also: "We have received several reports that district information found on third party websites are reflecting outdated 2021-2025 district information. Please use the 'New Voter Precinct Interactive Web Map' and 'View my registration' for up-to-date 2026 district information." Duties include maintenance of the voter registration database and "Supervision of tabulation and preparation of final canvassing reports." Contact vote@fbctx.gov.

entries.quote: Fetched directly 2026-09-21. Heading: "Empowering Voters. Defending Democracy." Observed: "The League of Women Voters is a nonpartisan, grassroots organization working to protect a
entries.observation: Fetched directly 2026-09-21. Heading: "Empowering Voters. Defending Democracy." Observed: "The League of Women Voters is a nonpartisan, grassroots organization working to protect and expand voting rights and ensure everyone is represented in our democracy." Voting tool: "Register to vote, find your polling place, look up your ballot, and more at VOTE411.org." "In 2024, more than 9.5 million people found nonpartisan voting resources on VOTE411". "In 2024 we protected more than 9.38 million voters in courts across the nation." Case titles on the page include "Protecting Mail-In Voting from the Trump Administration's Illegal Attacks" and "Supporting Fair Representation for All" (Louisiana v. Callais), with the page stating that in April 2026 the Supreme Court issued an opinion "effectively destroying the remainder of Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act".

entries.quote: Fetched directly 2026-09-21. Heading: "Verified Voting – Strengthening Democracy". Observed mission: "Verified Voting's mission is to strengthen democracy for all voters by promoti
entries.observation: Fetched directly 2026-09-21. Heading: "Verified Voting – Strengthening Democracy". Observed mission: "Verified Voting's mission is to strengthen democracy for all voters by promoting the responsible use of technology in elections." Tools listed: The Verifier ("The most comprehensive view of voting equipment use and post-election audit requirements across the United States."), Voting Equipment Database, Audit Law Database, Recount Law Database. Issues: Voting Equipment, Post-Election Audits, Paper Records, Internet Voting ("Internet voting is not private or secure and makes elections less trustworthy."), Election Security. Report tile: "The Election Chain of Custody Blueprint: A Review of the Law, Best Practices, and Messaging Tools" in partnership with Advance Elections and the Election Law Program.
